extra.WP-51:
Notes from the wave-2 boundary: contract change requests forwarded to this work package, with the lead's decisions. The architecture and wps.json already reflect the decisions; these notes give detail.
- [CR 7 from WP-02] An *Object with more than 8 members keeps a name index that Decode, Clone and every mutation maintain. Decode charges CostIndexEntry (48) per member for that index, so for large objects the *Object form costs more than Options.MapObjects (map[string]any); budgets and reservations must use the cost Decode returns for the form you actually build. Reads (Len, At, All, Index, Get, Has) never write, so one decoded tree may be shared read-only by any number of goroutines (the shared decoded body of 03 req 25 and 07 req 56). Any mutation (Set, SetAt, Delete, DeleteAt, Sort, transforms, merge) needs exclusive access, so call Clone (jsonval.Clone or Object.Clone) before editing a shared tree. MaxCostPerByte (33) bounds cost per input byte; the oversize budget multiple is the one recorded in 2.16 for request 5 (4 times the raw limit).
- [S1] Stages B, D, E and F are committed: internal/config/profile (WP-33), internal/config/overlay and internal/config/subst (WP-36) and internal/config/schemaview (WP-35). Read their package docs for the trees they hand on; overlay.Apply rewrites its input trees in place. WP-33 has five open findings and its YAML parser may change after the user's parser decision, so if you need it, use only its exported API (Parse, Options, Encode, EncodeJSON, FormatOf), which any parser change keeps.
- [S1 from WP-35] jsonschema/v6 v6.0.3 sets InstanceLocation for propertyNames and contentSchema errors to the validator's shared vloc slice without copying it, so a later sibling can overwrite it and the error reports the wrong instance path. Do not trust InstanceLocation for those error kinds; 07 req 18 already limits the detail to the keyword location. internal/config/schemaview shows the compile pattern (draft 2020-12, formats and content as annotations, a loader that refuses every URL).
- [S1 from WP-35] tree.Node.Get, schemaidx.Node.Select (one Get per dispatch case) and schemaidx.ItemElem (a Get or canonical JSON per element) scan linearly. A stage that calls them once per element of one large object or list becomes quadratic; build a per-object index or cache, as internal/config/schemaview does, and add a scale test with a few thousand members.
